title: Overlap
direction: Comparison: two round arches that share one stem; the stem they both own is knocked out, flat-topped and lit vermilion as the evidence of overlap, its foot cut at 45 degrees
rationale: The originality check overlays silhouettes and measures the overlap. Two near-identical forms offset so the overlap becomes a knocked-out gap makes the mechanism the mark.

sketchReview.notes: Keep: two identical arches nudged so the overlap forms the second counter; the one idea that is actually overlap. Fix: 68% stock similarity (double arch/tunnel), the white keyline halo is fussy, orange is near generic safety-orange. Make the overlap region the only accent and drop the halo. s3 is cleaner but is a slice, not overlap.

construction: Two identical round arches (130 stroke, 320 span, r160) side by side sharing one stem; shared stem lit vermilion #d12c12, 84 knockout, top cropped flat at y=440 (no lancet point, avoids flame/Gothic reading); one 45-degree chamfer (100) on the lit stem foot. Wordmark: plain DM Sans 700 lowercase, ink #101218, no custom cuts. Lockup: scale 1.3, gap 0.3 cap heights.

brand-fit.rationale: Precise, calm, crafted; crop-mark foot nods to heritage; vermilion away from Claude coral.

semantic-relevance.rationale: m from two arches plus a stem; the overlap idea (research meets verification) is implied, not self-evident.

distinctiveness.rationale: Arch-m with a coloured stem and clipped foot is ownable enough; the doorway/pillar family is crowded but this cut is specific.

memorability.rationale: Red stem inside black arches is a clear one-glance shape; flat crop makes it a little more generic.

simplicity.rationale: Three shapes, one accent, survives mono.

balance.rationale: Symmetric arches with an off-axis clipped foot give tension; stem top is tidy.

craft.rationale: Gap widened to 84, 16 px verify clean; lockup symbol sits above the baseline.

typography.rationale: Clean DM Sans 700, tight and even; neutral rather than distinctive.

color.rationale: Vermilion 4.76:1 on paper, 3.52:1 on dark, passes UI-graphic threshold; clear of coral.

cultural-fit.rationale: Fits developer-tool conventions without cliche; no avoid-list item.

premium-perception.rationale: Competent and calm, not yet luxurious; the pillar reading dilutes it slightly.

versatility.rationale: Works on light, dark, black and white; the m fades at 16 px but the silhouette holds.
